brief:
Gaza's Social Development Ministry strongly rejected Israeli statements claiming the hunger crisis has ended in the enclave, according to Shehab Wire. Officials characterized the assertions as a propaganda campaign designed to falsify the humanitarian reality on the ground and obscure the scale of the catastrophe unfolding across the territory.

The ministry's rebuke underscores the stark gap between Israeli public statements and conditions reported by aid organizations and Palestinian authorities documenting severe food shortages. Gazans face critical malnutrition, depleted food stocks, and deteriorating access to basic supplies as the conflict continues to disrupt distribution networks and commercial activity throughout the enclave.
